## Holes
«1» statements (no return, break or continue out of the hole; don't declare a name the sketch uses later): record in neighbors, in both directions, every pair of people the instructions count as one connection
«2» one expression of type number: the degree of separation between personA and personB over neighbors, or the 'no known relationship' value

## Imports already in the file
import * as arc from "open-arc";

## Types (verbatim)
export type FamilyTree = Record<string, string[]>;

export type DegreesOfSeparationFn = (familyTree: FamilyTree, personA: string, personB: string) => number;

## Intent
Exercise "relative-distance": implement `degreesOfSeparation`. Your task is to determine the degree of separation between two individuals in a family tree. - You will be given an input, with all parent names and their children. - Each name is unique, a child _can_ have one or two parents. - The degree of separation is defined as the shortest number of connections from one person to another. - If two individuals are not connected, return a value that represents "no known relationship." Please see the test cases for the actual implementation. ## Example Given the following family tree: ```text ┌──────────┐            ┌──────────┐ ┌───────────┐ │  Helena  │            │  Erdős   │ │  Shusaku  │ └───┬───┬──┘            └─────┬────┘ └──────┬────┘ ┌───┘   └───────┐             └──────┬──────┘ ▼               ▼                    ▼ ┌──────────┐     ┌────────┐          ┌──────────┐ │   Isla   │     │  Tariq │          │   Kevin  │ └────┬─────┘     └────┬───┘          └──────────┘ ▼                ▼ ┌─────────┐      ┌────────┐ │   Uma   │      │ Morphy │ └─────────┘      └────────┘ ``` The degree of separation between Tariq and Uma is 3 (Tariq → Helena → Isla → Uma). There's no known relationship between Isla and [Kevin][six-bacons], as there is no connection in the given data. The degree of separation between Uma and Isla is 1. ```exercism/note Isla and Tariq are siblings and have a separation of 1. Similarly, this implementation would report a separation of 2 from you to your father's brother. ``` [six-bacons]: https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Six_Degrees_of_Kevin_Bacon

## Calls allowed in fills
You may call: nothing (what the sketch itself calls). Any other call on an import or a port is rejected (OARC-E098); calls on locals and on functions a fill defines are fine.

none

{"args":[{"Khadija":["Mateo"],"Mateo":["Rami"]},"Khadija","Rami"],"expected":2,"name":"RelativeDistance > Two degrees of separation, grandchild"}
